title: Chapter 74: The Strength Of The Alliance Army
content:
Chapter 74: The Strength Of The Alliance Army

The Zerg army did not stop and continued to fight other evil god armies. This time, the rat army was unlucky.

These rat soldiers who believed in the evil god, the strange belief made them lose their cowardice in nature and burst into unimaginable madness.

Their madness may be useful in front of the local races, but they are now facing the Zerg. The Zerg does not care whether you are crazy or not. If you are weaker than the Zerg and have fewer Zerg than the Zerg, you have no chance.

[Remember the domain name of this site, Taiwan Novel Network → 𝓉𝓌𝓀𝒶𝓃.𝒸ℴ𝓂]

Hydralisks and puppies took turns to fight, and there was another charge. These rat people who had lost themselves and only had faith were liberated and turned into light and left.

The Zerg mother nest was upgraded to one star, and the strength of the Zerg army was upgraded and strengthened again, and the combat power was significantly improved.

After these two battles, the Zerg Puppies did not lose much personnel. Those Puppies that were seriously injured and affected their movements and continued to fight quietly went underground to recover under the cover of their companions.

The Zerg wiped out two evil god armies, and the remaining several evil god believers' armies had surrounded them. The Zerg army quickly withdrew to the main formation of the Alliance army.

The Hydralisk retreated into the long-range attack square, and the Puppies guarded outside the square.

As soon as the evil god believers' army arrived, they launched a crazy charge. Under the command of Wu Qing, the Puppies stood in a clever position and gave up the shooting range for the 7,000 long-range attack elite troops of their side.

Whether it was direct shooting or projectile shooting, they could exert their full strength without being affected.

"Spirit God! Give me strength!"

The bear goblins, lizardmen and evil god believers of various races all shouted the name of God and rushed towards the Alliance army without hesitation.

"Shoot!"

With a fierce order, 2,000 Hydralisks, 1,000 Tiger Cavalry, 1,000 Feather Tribe Archers, 1,000 Fox Tribe Cavalry, 1,000 Wolf Cavalry and 1,000 Stone Tribe Heavy Infantry all launched long-range attacks.

Hydralisks and Feather Tribe Archers are professional long-range attack arms, and the power and accuracy of their spikes and bows and arrows are naturally needless to say.

The long-range weapons of Tiger Cavalry, Fox Cavalry and Wolf Cavalry are all javelins, and there is a section of open space in front of their square formations for them to run and throw.

These are the most elite arms of several major territories of the alliance. The javelins they throw are fast, far, and fierce, and their lethality is very strong.

The only infantry in the alliance army, the Stone Tribe Heavy Infantry, supported by the strong physique of the Stone Tribe, have never fallen behind during the march.

Their long-range weapons are their homemade small hand axes. In their hands, this kind of long-range weapon has a stronger attack distance and lethality than javelins.

A thousand hand axes flew out, and the enemies were cleared and fell to the ground in large numbers.

Faced with the long-range attack of 7,000 elite soldiers, the ordinary evil god believers who were guarding the periphery of the evil god army camp were directly stunned!

Just one volley of fire interrupted the offensive of the evil god believers.

This made the Tengu cavalry watching the battle also shocked. They did not expect the combat power of the alliance army to be so strong!

In the two encirclement and annihilation battles of the Zerg puppies just now, they were very far away, and their vision was restricted by interference. They could not see much, but they felt that the Zerg’s fighting style was very crazy, no worse than the evil god believers.

Now that they feel the attack ability of the alliance army at a relatively close distance, they are instantly shocked. Since the alliance army, a potential destabilizing factor, has such a strong combat power, they must report the situation as soon as possible.

One thing Wu Qing likes about the evil god believers is that they are not afraid to retreat when they are hit hard. That spirit of sending death is very consistent with Wu Qing’s requirements for the enemy.

If a normal army was attacked like this, even if there was no order to retreat, the soldiers would retreat and flee.

But the army of the evil god believers would not do that. They were still charging forward madly with the fear of death!

"Swallow fire!"

Meng ordered another volley.

The battlefield killing efficiency of volley fire is the highest. Normal armies are not like hydralisks. Even the most elite troops have limited long-range attack weapons and cannot be wasted easily.

Another uniform volley!

Spikes, arrows, javelins and hand axes rained down on the evil god believers who continued to charge.

The dead evil god believers had turned into light and disappeared, and the ground was full of wounded people struggling.

The second volley, more evil god believers turned into light and disappeared.

"This independent territory alliance has the support of gods behind it! They are sacrificing on the battlefield!"

The head of the Tengu cavalry who was responsible for monitoring the alliance army became more solemn.

"Send someone to report again!"

"Yes!"

A team of Tengu cavalry took the order and left.

As long as they see sacrifice, no matter it is friend or foe, people in this world will pay attention to it.

In the first two battles, due to the distance, he didn't see it clearly, but now this battle in front of him made him see it clearly.

"Is this the battlefield sacrifice ability of the Zerg?"

Yu Chong and Bai Yan also watched such a scene at close range for the first time, which made them more curious about the master behind the Zerg.

On the battlefield, the Hydralisk had already started free shooting, attacking those who escaped after the volley, and the five thousand elites were waiting in full battle formation, waiting for a command from Meng, and then they would attack the enemy again.

After two volleys, the commanders of the evil god believers' army finally saw the huge gap in combat power between the two sides. The evil god believers' army stopped charging and began to line up outside the range of the long-range arms of the alliance army.

The first army of the evil god believers who surrounded them had a strength of more than 30,000. After two rounds of killing by the puppies and two volleys of fire by two thousand hydralisks and five thousand elite alliance soldiers, their strength had been reduced to a level that was almost the same as that of the alliance army.

Wu Qing and Meng would definitely not give the evil god believers a chance to calmly organize their troops.

"All troops, keep the formation!"

"Attack!"

Meng gave the order to attack!

Except for the Zerg troops, the alliance army was almost all cavalry, and the speed of marching in formation was very fast.

The Zerg puppies rushed in front of the battle formation, killed all the enemy wounded on the ground, and cleared a smooth path.

Although the evil god believers were crazy and fearless, they were still in the category of normal creatures. It took time to organize their troops and form a formation like a normal army.

Before they could form a formation, the long-range attack troops of the advancing alliance army enveloped them within the range of fire.

"Send a volley!"

As Meng's terrifying order was issued, more than 7,000 long-range attack weapons instantly fell into the army of the evil god's followers, which had not yet formed.

The army of the evil god's followers suffered a great loss of personnel again!

Faced with such a situation, the evil god's followers' faith prevented them from retreating, and they could only choose a futile counterattack.

"Prepare for long-range attack!"

"Fire!"

The evil god's followers also launched a long-range counterattack.

But their long-range attacks such as stones and javelins seemed very amateurish in comparison. The range was only enough to reach the puppies in front of the alliance army's battle formation, and the power was also uneven, unable to cause effective damage to the puppies whose shells had been upgraded again.
